t: Why the heat and the cold get that extreme
a: اشْتَكَتِ النَّارُ إِلَى رَبِّهَا، فَقَالَتْ رَبِّ أَكَلَ بَعْضِي بَعْضًا، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا بِنَفَسَيْنِ نَفَسٍ فِي الشِّتَاءِ وَنَفَسٍ فِي الصَّيْفِ
p: Ishtakati-n-nāru ilā rabbihā, fa-qālat rabbi akala baʿḍī baʿḍā, fa-adhina lahā bi-nafasayn: nafasin fi-sh-shitāʾi wa nafasin fi-ṣ-ṣayf
m: The Fire complained to its Lord and said: my Lord, parts of me are consuming other parts. So He permitted it two breaths, one in winter and one in summer.
